product.title: Classic Manhattan Electric Bike Tour

description.text: Ride through Manhattan with a local guide on an electric bike route built for efficient sightseeing and neighborhood context. This experience blends major skyline viewpoints with quieter side streets so you can cover more ground in about half a day without an all-day effort.

highlights: Explore Lower and Midtown Manhattan on an electric bike with a licensed guide
Cover classic skyline and landmark corridors in roughly 3.5 to 4 hours
Start at 79 Chambers St and finish near 56 W 56th St for cross-town convenience
Designed for travelers who want active sightseeing with manageable effort

itineraryItems.title: City Hall & Civic Center
itineraryItems.description: Begin in Lower Manhattan with a quick orientation and safety briefing before rolling north.

itineraryItems.title: Hudson River Greenway
itineraryItems.description: Use protected bike lanes for a steady riverfront segment with skyline photo opportunities.

itineraryItems.title: Central Manhattan Highlights
itineraryItems.description: Ride through key Midtown corridors while your guide shares local history and route context.

itineraryItems.title: Finish Near Central Park South
itineraryItems.description: End near 56 W 56th St with recommendations for nearby food and transit connections.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
